description: This file defines a PHP class 'ClaimExpenseDecorator' which serves as a wrapper for the 'ClaimExpense' entity, providing methods to interact with claim requests, expense types, and date formatting within the context of an HR management system. It incorporates traits for common functionalities, utilizes dependency injection for services, and facilitates data manipulation and retrieval related to claim expenses in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing convenient methods to manipulate ClaimExpense entities, including setting claim requests and expense types by their IDs, and formatting expense date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific ClaimExpense entity.

methods.name: setClaimRequestByRequestId
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with the ClaimExpense based on the request ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest entity by its ID.

methods.name: getClaimService
methods.description: Provides access to the ClaimService instance via dependency injection.

methods.name: setExpenseTypeByExpenseTypeId
methods.description: Sets the expense type on the ClaimExpense entity based on the expense type ID.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string of the claim expense in 'Y-m-d' format.
